`get()` indexed `_store` directly, so looking up a key that was never
cached raised a KeyError. Callers expect a cache miss to be a normal,
non-exceptional outcome, which forced each of them to wrap the call in
try/except or pre-check with `in`.

Check membership first and return None when the key is absent, so a miss
is reported through the return value rather than an exception.

    backoff: float,
    max_delay: float,
